notes: DRAFT for C-STORY-b (spec: drafts/content/C-STORY-review.md). One new fact per tier, White to Brown/Black. Black is out of scope (Jay). W2: the 'who' (the Lost Lightbearer was a student, Sensei's friend) is guessable for attentive 12-14 readers around Brown, not before. W1: Sensei hints at White, Orange, Blue, Red/Black; reveal after Brown (brown-black tier). kidLine = ages 6+, read aloud. olderReaderLine = Bestiary/Relic deeper text. faithNote = swappable faith layer only; KJV checked against bible-api.com (translation=kjv) 2026-10-26; KJV is a placeholder until Jay answers sign wording vs KJV. Place names are PLACEHOLDERs awaiting Jay. Nothing shipped is changed; see mystery-ladder.md for suggested line changes.

tiers.factRevealed: The light broke into pieces, and the pieces are still in the Tower.
tiers.kidLine: The light broke, but it is still here!
tiers.olderReaderLine: Glass this warm was never meant for the dark. Light that broken still shines.

senseiHint.where: Dojo: an old lantern on Sensei's shelf
senseiHint.line: Sensei glances at an old lantern, then smiles. "Let's train."

faithNote.text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
faithNote.undertone: Light still shines in the dark; the shadow can't put it out.

tiers.factRevealed: A storm broke the light. Nobody broke it on purpose.
tiers.kidLine: A big storm broke the light. It was no one's fault.
tiers.olderReaderLine: Storms don't choose. Only what we do after them is ours.

tiers.factRevealed: On the storm night, one seat at supper was left empty.
tiers.kidLine: Someone left supper early. A bowl is saved for them.
tiers.olderReaderLine: Soup for everyone, and one bowl kept warm. Someone here is still expected home.

senseiHint.where: Dojo: Sensei after the Orange Gate
senseiHint.line: Sensei sets out one extra cup of tea, just in case.

tiers.factRevealed: The shadow is many small fears stacked up, not one monster.
tiers.kidLine: The shadow is made of little worries.
tiers.olderReaderLine: Fear grows when you stack it alone. Name each one, and the stack falls.

faithNote.text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
faithNote.undertone: Fear is answered with trust, not with more fear.

tiers.factRevealed: The light was not lost. Someone carried it up through the rain to keep it safe.
tiers.kidLine: Someone is keeping the light safe!
tiers.olderReaderLine: The log has one line for that night: carried, not lost. Someone chose the stairs over shelter.

senseiHint.where: Dojo: Senpai's line after the Blue Gate
senseiHint.line: Senpai: "Sensei used to climb with a friend. Sensei never says who."

faithNote.text: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee:
faithNote.undertone: Through deep water, someone is never alone.

tiers.factRevealed: The carrier used a shield to cover the light, and the shield cracked.
tiers.kidLine: They kept the light safe with a shield.
tiers.olderReaderLine: A cracked shield means it held. Someone took the rain so the light wouldn't.

faithNote.text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped:
faithNote.undertone: A shield that protects, and a heart that trusts.

tiers.factRevealed: The carrier is still up there, holding on and waiting for help.
tiers.kidLine: They are waiting for help. Let's keep climbing!
tiers.olderReaderLine: The echoes said give up. One voice kept answering: "I will hold the light until help comes."

senseiHint.where: Dojo: Sensei after the Red/Black Gate
senseiHint.line: Sensei rereads an old note, then tucks it away. "Keep climbing."

tiers.factRevealed: The carrier was once a student of this Tower, who trained the same forms you do.
tiers.foundIn: Relic: Student Sash + Root Library page
tiers.kidLine: The helper was a student, just like you!
tiers.olderReaderLine: An old practice sash, its name too faded to read. Same forms, same stairs, same door you came in by.

faithNote.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
faithNote.undertone: A lamp for the path, for every student who climbs.

tiers.factRevealed: Sensei trained with the carrier long ago, and has hoped every day they would come home.
tiers.foundIn: Sensei scene after the Brown/Black Gate (C-STORY-h)
tiers.kidLine: Sensei knows them! Sensei kept hoping.
tiers.olderReaderLine: "We trained side by side. I kept a lantern lit for them every night."

senseiHint.line: Sensei: "They were my friend. Let's bring them home together."

faithNote.text: But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
faithNote.undertone: Someone watching the road for a friend to come home; no blame, only welcome.
